Based on the retrieved knowledge, here is a summary of your resume [Source 1]: You are a B.Tech CSE student with strong foundations in Data Structures, Algorithms, and Object-Oriented Programming, experienced in building scalable full-stack applications and backend systems. You are passionate about solving real-world problems using technology and interested in applying software engineering in financial services and large-scale systems.

Your work experience [Source 2] includes a Summer Research Intern position at SRM University-AP, where you built an end-to-end ML system using Gradient Boosting to predict credit scores, and a Core Team Member position at Google Developer Groups (GDG), where you tracked registration data and increased participant engagement.

You have proficiency in various programming languages [Source 3], including Python, JavaScript, C, C++, and Java, as well as experience with web technologies, backend and APIs, databases, machine learning, and data science.

Additionally, you have obtained several certifications [Source 4], including Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2025 Certified Data Science Professional, Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 17 Developer, and MongoDB Certified Associate Developer (Node.js).

Note that [Source 5] appears to be a medical report and is not relevant to your resume. If you would like me to elaborate on any specific aspect of your resume, please let me know.
